Hummus and Veggie Patties
By: gypsy696
Published: Sunday, December 12, 2010 - 5:59am

Ingredients




3 tablespoons of hummus
1 1/2 cups of zuccini, peppers, carrots
2 wholes jalepeno peppers
1/2 teaspoon of curry powder
A pinch of tumeric powder
1 cup of semolina

Preparation

1 Chop up the zuccini, peppers and carrots roughly. 2 Toss the veggies into a blender and blitz the life out of them. 3 Add the hummus, jalepenos and the spices. Mix again. 4 Form patties of your desired shape. 5 Coat the patties uniformly in the semolina (or bread crumbs, if you have them). 6 Deep fry till a golden brown. 7 Enjoy with a mint chutney or Tabasco
